thesis: ASML is the only company on Earth that makes EUV lithography machines, and the AI fab build-out is pulling orders forward: Q1 2026 sales of EUR 8.77B (+13% y/y) at 53% gross margin, FY2026 guidance raised to EUR 36-40B, a EUR 38.8B backlog, and record EUR 13.2B Q4-2025 bookings. The problem is the price of perfection: after a +121% twelve-month run to ~$1,855 (~57x annualized earnings for low-teens revenue growth), the stock has re-rated far above its historical multiple while China export legislation threatens its last remaining China sales channel. July 15 earnings are the next catalyst - and the first look at bookings since ASML stopped disclosing them quarterly.
catalysts: Q2 2026 results July 15, 2026: guidance EUR 8.4-9.0B sales, GM 51-52%; first bookings update since disclosure was pulled
FY2026 guidance raise to EUR 36-40B already in hand; further raises if TSMC/Intel/Samsung fab acceleration continues
High-NA EUV adoption milestones toward 2027 delivery targets
EUV order wave: EUR 7.4B of EUV orders in the record Q4-2025 bookings
Any resolution (either way) of US legislation on China DUV sales - removes an overhang or crystallizes it
risk_factors: Valuation: ~57x annualized EPS for ~13% revenue growth is roughly double the historical multiple; the re-rating IS the risk
US legislative threat could sever remaining China sales; regulatory risk is structural and outside management control
ASML stopped disclosing quarterly order figures - reduced transparency into the leading indicator right at the cycle's most-watched moment
Slow immersion sales start and doubts about 2027 delivery targets flagged in coverage
AI capex pullback would compress orders and the elevated multiple simultaneously (5d -5.05% shows sensitivity)

q1_2026_net_sales.source: ASML Q1 2026 results (asml.com / earnings call transcript)
